points.en: Ad hoc charging: you can charge without registering or signing a contract with the operator.
points.sr: Punjenje bez registracije (ad hoc): punite bez registracije i bez ugovora sa operaterom.
points.ru: Разовая зарядка (ad hoc): можно заряжаться без регистрации и без договора с оператором.

points.en: Operators of public chargers must offer ad hoc charging with a payment method widely used in the EU.
points.sr: Operateri javnih punjača moraju da omoguće punjenje bez registracije, plaćanjem sredstvom koje je široko u upotrebi u EU.
points.ru: Операторы публичных зарядок обязаны давать разовую зарядку с оплатой способом, широко распространённым в ЕС.

points.en: New public chargers of 50 kW and more installed from 13 April 2024 must take bank cards through a card reader or a contactless device.
points.sr: Novi javni punjači od 50 kW i više, postavljeni od 13. aprila 2024, moraju da primaju bankovne kartice preko čitača ili beskontaktnog uređaja.
points.ru: Новые публичные зарядки от 50 кВт, установленные с 13 апреля 2024 года, должны принимать банковские карты через считыватель или бесконтактное устройство.

points.en: New public chargers below 50 kW may instead offer online payment, for example a QR code of the charger.
points.sr: Novi javni punjači ispod 50 kW mogu umesto toga da nude plaćanje preko interneta, na primer QR kodom punjača.
points.ru: Новые публичные зарядки до 50 кВт могут вместо этого предлагать оплату онлайн, например по QR-коду зарядки.

points.en: From 1 January 2027 this also applies to existing stations of 50 kW and more on the TEN-T road network and in safe and secure parking areas.
points.sr: Od 1. januara 2027. ovo važi i za postojeće stanice od 50 kW i više na putnoj mreži TEN-T i na bezbednim parkiralištima.
points.ru: С 1 января 2027 года это касается и существующих станций от 50 кВт на дорожной сети TEN-T и на охраняемых парковках.

points.en: The ad hoc price and its parts must be shown at the station before the session starts.
points.sr: Cena punjenja bez registracije i njeni delovi moraju biti prikazani na stanici pre početka punjenja.
points.ru: Разовая цена и её составляющие должны быть показаны на станции до начала зарядки.

apps.name: EnBW mobility+
apps.note: Two official EnBW pages name the same 17 countries of the EnBW HyperNetz.
apps.note_sr: Dve zvanične stranice EnBW navode istih 17 zemalja mreže EnBW HyperNetz.
apps.note_ru: Две официальные страницы EnBW называют одни и те же 17 стран сети EnBW HyperNetz.

apps.name: Plugsurfing
apps.note: Official pages give 26–28 countries without naming them; only countries named on official pages are marked (Portugal launch 15.06.2026, Spain).
apps.note_sr: Zvanične stranice navode 26–28 zemalja bez imena; označene su samo zemlje imenovane na zvaničnim stranicama (Portugal od 15.06.2026, Španija).
apps.note_ru: Официальные страницы называют 26–28 стран без списка; отмечены только страны, названные на официальных страницах (Португалия с 15.06.2026, Испания).

apps.name: Electroverse
apps.note: Official press release (27.08.2024) gives a count of 40 countries without a list.
apps.note_sr: Zvanično saopštenje (27.08.2024) navodi 40 zemalja bez spiska.
apps.note_ru: Официальный пресс-релиз (27.08.2024) называет 40 стран без списка.

apps.name: Chargemap Pass
apps.note: Official page not read on the check date; country list to be added.
apps.note_sr: Zvanična stranica nije pročitana na dan provere; spisak zemalja sledi.
apps.note_ru: Официальная страница в день проверки не прочитана; список стран будет добавлен.

apps.name: Shell Recharge
apps.note: The former official country list (Shell support) now redirects elsewhere; no current list found.
apps.note_sr: Raniji zvanični spisak zemalja (Shell podrška) sada vodi drugde; aktuelni spisak nije pronađen.
apps.note_ru: Прежний официальный список стран (поддержка Shell) теперь перенаправляет в другой раздел; актуальный список не найден.

apps.name: Tesla Supercharger (other EVs)
apps.note: Tesla says sites are open to other EVs in selected markets through the Tesla app; the countries are only on the interactive Find Us map.
apps.note_sr: Tesla navodi da su lokacije otvorene za druge automobile na odabranim tržištima kroz Tesla aplikaciju; zemlje su samo na interaktivnoj mapi Find Us.
apps.note_ru: Tesla пишет, что станции открыты для других электромобилей на отдельных рынках через приложение Tesla; страны — только на интерактивной карте Find Us.

DE.note: No motorway toll for passenger cars. The federal truck toll applies to vehicles over 3.5 t. Some private crossings charge a toll (e.g. Warnow tunnel, Herren tunnel).
DE.note_en: The Toll Collect toll is for trucks over 3.5 t only.
DE.note_sr: Naplata Toll Collect važi samo za kamione preko 3,5 t.
DE.note_ru: Сбор Toll Collect — только для грузовиков тяжелее 3,5 т.

AT.note: Motorway vignette, sold as a digital vignette (1-day, 10-day, 2-month and annual). Separate section tolls on A9 Pyhrn, A10 Tauern, A11 Karawanken, A13 Brenner and S16 Arlberg. Shop: https://shop.asfinag.at/en/
AT.note_en: Plus separate section tolls (e.g. A9, A10, A13, S16).
AT.note_sr: Plus posebne putarine za pojedine deonice (npr. A9, A10, A13, S16).
AT.note_ru: Плюс отдельная плата за участки (например A9, A10, A13, S16).

CH.operator: BAZG (Federal Office for Customs and Border Security)
CH.note: Annual motorway charge (national roads levy) only, as an e-vignette or a sticker. Citizen info: https://www.ch.ch/de/fahrzeuge-und-verkehr/autos-und-andere-fahrzeuge/autobahnvignette/ . Some tunnels charge separately (e.g. Great St Bernard).

SI.note: E-vignette (e-vinjeta) linked to the licence plate. Shop: evinjeta.dars.si. The Karawanken tunnel toll is charged separately.
SI.note_en: The Karawanken tunnel is tolled separately.

HR.note: Toll by distance through closed toll plazas; ENC tag available (https://www.hac.hr/hr/cestarina/enc). HAC is building a new electronic free-flow toll system. Other concessionaires: BINA-Istra, Autocesta Zagreb-Macelj.

HU.note: E-matrica: national (weekly, monthly, annual) and county annual. Link is NÚSZ's official 2026 price list PDF. Prices were not read because the fetch was unavailable. Main site: nemzetiutdij.hu

CZ.operator: State Fund for Transport Infrastructure / Ministry of Transport (eDalnice)
CZ.note: Electronic motorway vignette (10-day, 30-day, annual) bought at the official e-shop edalnice.cz. The e-shop warns about unofficial resellers.

SK.note: Electronic motorway vignette (eznamka.sk). A new 2026 edition was announced on the site.

RS.note: Toll by distance at toll plazas (cash, card, ENP tag: https://www.putevi-srbije.rs/index.php/sr/enp). Tags work with Montenegro, North Macedonia and Republika Srpska under interoperability agreements. The Koridori Srbije and Moravski koridor sections are also tolled.

BA.operator: JP Autoceste FBiH (Federation); Autoputevi Republike Srpske (RS: https://autoputevirs.com/lat/)
BA.note: Toll by distance at plazas on the A1 (FBiH) and on RS motorways. The ACC/ENP tags work across BiH ('one tag for all of BiH') and are being linked with HAC (Croatia).

ME.note: No general vignette. Point tolls on the Sozina tunnel and on the Smokovac-Mateševac motorway section (Bar-Boljare A1), with electronic toll tags (https://monteput.me/elektronska-naplata-putarine-niza-cijena-tag-uredaja-i-nizi-iznos-minimalne-uplate/). Tags work with Serbia.
ME.note_en: Sozina tunnel and the Smokovac–Mateševac motorway section.
ME.note_sr: Tunel Sozina i deonica autoputa Smokovac–Mateševac.
ME.note_ru: Туннель Созина и участок автомагистрали Смоковац — Матешевац.

MK.operator: Public Enterprise for State Roads (ЈП за државни патишта)
MK.note: Toll plazas on motorways (cash, card, M-tag). The system is moving towards open-road (free-flow) tolling; see the 27.05.2026 notice to toll users.

AL.operator: Concession on Rruga e Kombit (Milot-Morinë, A1); concession agency ATRAKO
AL.note: A single toll point (near Kalimash) on the A1 Milot-Morinë 'Rruga e Kombit'. Other roads have no car toll. The Milot-Fier PPP corridor is planned with tolls. No operator e-shop page was found. LOW confidence on the URL: it is a government concession page, not a toll-operator page.
AL.note_en: One toll point on the A1 Milot–Morinë; source is the concession agency page.
AL.note_sr: Jedna naplatna stanica na A1 Milot–Morinë; izvor je stranica agencije za koncesije.
AL.note_ru: Один пункт оплаты на A1 Милот — Морине; источник — страница агентства концессий.

GR.operator: Several concessionaires: Attiki Odos, Egnatia Odos, Olympia Odos, Nea Odos/Kentriki Odos, Moreas, Aegean Motorway, Gefyra (Rio-Antirrio)
GR.note: Toll plazas run by each operator. One interoperable e-pass works across operators. The linked page is Attiki Odos's interoperability page. Rio-Antirrio bridge: https://gefyra.gr/en/prices/Dialeitourgikothta-GRITS/

BG.note: E-vignette (weekend, weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual). Prices changed from 1 May (see the bgtoll.bg news). Danube bridges at Ruse and Vidin charge separate fees.
BG.note_en: Danube bridges at Ruse and Vidin are tolled separately.
BG.note_sr: Mostovi na Dunavu kod Rusea i Vidina se plaćaju posebno.
BG.note_ru: Мосты через Дунай у Русе и Видина оплачиваются отдельно.

RO.operator: CNAIR (Compania Națională de Administrare a Infrastructurii Rutiere)
RO.note: Rovinieta (time-based e-vignette) is required on national roads and motorways. From 1 Oct 2026 the rovinieta and the new TollRo tariff are paid only through the official channels of the new electronic road-charging system. The CNAIR page says the older erovinieta.ro/SMS channels are no longer valid. TollRo is understood to be distance-based for heavy vehicles; this was not checked for cars. Bridge tolls (peaj) are separate: Fetești-Cernavodă on the A2 and Giurgiu-Ruse. Note: roviniete.ro is a private reseller, not CNAIR.
RO.note_en: From 1 October 2026 the rovinieta is sold only through the new official system; bridge tolls are separate.
RO.note_sr: Od 1. oktobra 2026. rovinieta se kupuje samo kroz novi zvanični sistem; mostovi se plaćaju posebno.
RO.note_ru: С 1 октября 2026 года ровиньета продаётся только через новую официальную систему; мосты оплачиваются отдельно.

TR.note: Barrier-free electronic toll by distance on motorways and bridges via an HGS sticker or OGS tag; no cash. Toll tables: https://www.kgm.gov.tr/Sayfalar/KGM/SiteTr/Otoyollar/OtoyolKopruUcret/KopruGecisUcret.aspx . Foreign-plated vehicles: https://www.kgm.gov.tr/Sayfalar/KGM/SiteTr/Otoyollar/YabanciPlakaliAraclar.aspx

IT.note: Toll by distance and vehicle class, mostly at closed toll barriers (cash, card, Telepass/EETS tags). Some open-barrier and free-flow sections exist. How it is calculated: https://www.autostrade.it/en/servizi-al-cliente/pedaggio/come-si-calcola-il-pedaggio
